#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次 | native/模型/库未知 | home/权限/样本/路由 | 路径分开核 |
| 持续 | 摘要/embedding/过滤/反思/存储未知 | 核出处/纠错 | 前台3秒非总费上限 |
| 故障 | 重建/重复/外部调用未知 | 查队列/部分写/恢复 | 未落库队列非持久 |
| 退出 | 库/备份/模型历史未知 | 排空/清凭据/核删除 | 停用非数据撤回 |

**KB**, **multi-modal**, **tool memory**, and **enterprise-grade** optimizations built in.\n\n### Key Features\n\n- **Unified Memory API**: A single API to add, retrieve, edit, and delete reasoned together in one memory system.\n- **Multi-Cube Knowledge Base Management**: Manage multiple knowledge bases as composable memory cubes, enabling isolation, controlled sharing, and dynamic composition across users, projects, and agents.\n- **Asynchronous Ingestion via MemScheduler**: Run memory operations asynchronously with millisecond-level latency for production stability under high concurrency.\n- **Memory Feedback & Correction**: Refine memory with natural-language feedback—correcting, supplementing, or replacing existing memories over time.\n\n\n### News\n\n- **2026-08-17** · Reflection / α deliberately empty.\n    const persistStart = now();\n    const rows = buildRows(scored, summaries, vecs, input.episode);\n    const persisted = await persistRows(rows, input, warnings, {}, seenSignatures);\n    if (!persisted) {\n      // emit capture.failed handled inside persistRows on hard fail.\n      return finalResult(\n        input,\n        startedAt,\n        [],\n        scored.map(toCandidate(rows)),\n        {\n          extract: extractMs,\n          normalize: normalizeMs,\n          reflect: 0,\n          alpha: 0,\n          summarize: summarizeMs,\n          embed: embedMs,\n          persist: now() - persistStart,\n        },\n        llmCalls,\n        warnings,\n      );\n    }\n    const persistMs = now() - persistStart;\n\n    const result = finalResult(\n      input,\n      startedAt,\n      rows.map((r) => r.id),\n      buildTraceCandidates(scored, rows),\n      {\n        extract: extractMs,\n        normalize: normalizeMs,\n        reflect: 0,\n        alpha: 0,\n        summarize: summarizeMs,\n        embed: embedMs,\n        persist: persistMs,\n      },\n      llmCalls,\n      warnings,\n    );\n    log.info(\"capture.lite.done\", {\n      episodeId: input.episode.id,\n      sessionId: input.episode.sessionId,\n      traces: result.traceIds.length,\n      llmCalls,\n      totalMs: result.completedAt - startedAt,\n      warnings: warnings.length,\n    });\n    // Emit `capture.lite.done` so the api_logs table gets a per-turn\n    // `memory_add` row. extractStart;\n\n    const normStart = now();\n    const normalized = normalizeSteps(raw, deps.cfg);\n    const normalizeMs = now() - normStart;\n\n    if (normalized.length === 0) {\n      return emptyResult(input, startedAt, {\n        extract: extractMs,\n        normalize: normalizeMs,\n      }, llmCalls, warnings);\n    }\n\n    const scored: ScoredStep[] = normalized.map((s) => ({\n      ...s,\n      reflection: { text: null, alpha: 0, usable: false, source: \"none\" },\n    }));\n\n    const summarizeStart = now();\n    const { summaries, summarizeMs } = await runSummarize(\n      scored,\n      summarizeStart,\n      llmCalls,\n      warnings,\n      { episodeId: input.episode.id, phase: \"lightweight\" },\n    );\n\n    const { vecs: summaryOnlyVecs, embedMs } = await runEmbed(\n      scored,\n      summaries,\n      warnings,\n      { summaryOnly: true },\n    );\n\n    const persistStart = now();\n    const rows = buildRows(scored, summaries, summaryOnlyVecs, input.episode, {\n      lightweightMemory: true,\n    });\n    const persisted = await persistRows(rows, input, warnings, {\n      skipActionVectorRetry: true,\n    }, seenSignatures);\n    if (!persisted) {\n      return finalResult(\n        input,\n        startedAt,\n        [],\n        scored.map(toCandidate(rows)),\n        {\n          extract: extractMs,\n          normalize: normalizeMs,\n          reflect: 0,\n          alpha: 0,\n          summarize: summarizeMs,\n          embed: embedMs,\n          persist: now() - persistStart,\n        },\n        llmCalls,\n        warnings,\n      );\n    }\n    const persistMs = now() - persistStart;\n\n    const result = finalResult(\n      input,\n      startedAt,\n      rows.map((r) => r.id),\n      buildTraceCandidates(scored, rows),\n      {\n        extract: extractMs,\n        normalize: normalizeMs,\n        reflect: 0,\n        alpha: 0,\n        summarize: summarizeMs,\n        embed: embedMs,\n        persist: persistMs,\n      },\n      llmCalls,\n      warnings,\n    );\n    log.info(\"capture.lightweight.done\", {\n      episodeId: input.episode.id,\n      sessionId: input.episode.sessionId,\n      traces: result.traceIds.length,\n      llmCalls,\n      totalMs: result.completedAt - Then fires `capture.done` so the\n   * reward subscriber computes R_human + back-propagates V.\n   */\n  async function runReflect(input: CaptureInput): Promise<CaptureResult> {\n    const startedAt = now();\n    const warnings: CaptureResult[\"warnings\"] = [];\n    const llmCalls = newLlmCounters();\n\n    emit({\n      kind: \"capture.started\",\n      episodeId: input.episode.id,\n      sessionId: input.episode.sessionId,\n    });\n\n    // Re-derive normalized steps from the (now closed) episode so the\n    // batch scorer sees state/action/outcome in the exact same shape\n    // it would have seen during a per-step pass.\n    const extractStart = now();\n    const rawAll = extractSteps(input.episode);\n    const extractMs = now() - extractStart;\n\n    const normStart = now();\n    const normalized = normalizeSteps(rawAll, deps.cfg);\n    const normalizeMs = now() - normStart;\n\n    // Pair each normalized step with its already-persisted trace row.\n    // Matching by timestamp alone is not stable during startup recovery:\n    // recovered snapshots are rebuilt from trace rows and the extractor may\n    // shift duplicate tool timestamps. Use content signatures first, and in\n    // recovered replay allow a timing-insensitive tool signature fallback.\n    const existing = deps.tracesRepo.listAllForEpisode(input.episode.id);\n    const recoveredReplay = isRecoveredReplay(input.episode);\n    const matcher = createTraceMatcher(existing, { allowRelaxedToolTiming: recoveredReplay });\n    const matchedRows = normalized.map((s) => matcher.take(s));\n    // A recovered snapshot is reconstructed from the trace rows that we are\n    // about to patch. Fail before any of those side effects.\n    //\n    // Partial matches remain recoverable: their matching rows are patched\n    // and the unmatched tail follows the existing bounded-orphan policy.\n    if (\n      recoveredReplay &&\n      normalized.length > 0 &&\n      matchedRows.every((row) => row === null)\n    ) {\n      const error = new MemosError(\n        ERROR_CODES.CONFLICT,\n        \"recovered replay did not match any persisted trace rows\",\n        {\n          episodeId: input.episode.id,\n          normalizedSteps: normalized.length,\n          persistedTraces: existing.length,\n        },\n      );\n      emit({\n        kind: \"capture.failed\",\n        episodeId: input.episode.id,\n        sessionId: input.episode.sessionId,\n        stage: \"match\",\n        error: {\n          code: ERROR_CODES.CONFLICT,\n          message: error.message,\n        },\n      });\n      throw error;\n    }\n    const orphanEntries = normalized\n      .map((step, index) => ({ step, index }))\n      .filter(({ index }) => matchedRows[index] === null);\n    if (orphanEntries.length > 0) {\n      log.warn(\"reflect.orphan_steps\", {\n        episodeId: input.episode.id,\n        count: orphanEntries.length,\n        action: recoveredReplay ? \"action\" : \"summary\";\n    into.set(id, {\n      tier: \"tier2\",\n      refKind: \"trace\",\n      refId: id,\n      // Vector hits seed cosine with the score; keyword hits start at 0\n      // and depend on RRF for ranking.\n      cosine: isVec ? null,\n  };\n}\n\nexport function ownerParams(ns: RuntimeNamespace, prefix = \"owner\"): Record<string, unknown> {\n  const owner = ownerFromNamespace(ns);\n  return {\n    [`${prefix}_agent_kind`]: owner.ownerAgentKind,\n    [`${prefix}_profile_id`]: owner.ownerProfileId,\n    [`${prefix}_workspace_id`]: owner.ownerWorkspaceId,\n  };\n}\n\nexport function normalizeShareScope(scope: unknown): ShareScope {\n  if (scope === \"local\") return \"public\";\n  if (scope === \"public\" || scope === \"hub\") return scope;\n  return \"private\";\n}\n\nexport function visibilityWhere(\n  ns: RuntimeNamespace | null | undefined,\n  alias = \"\",\n): VisibilityWhere {\n  const col = (name: string) => `${alias ?       "content": "import type { ToolCallDTO } from \"../../../agent-contract/dto.js\";\nimport type { EmbeddingVector, EpisodeId, SessionId, ShareScope, TraceId, TraceRow } from \"../../types.js\";\nimport type { StorageDb, TraceListFilter } from \"../types.js\";\nimport { buildInClause, buildInsert, buildUpdate } from \"../tx.js\";\nimport { scanAndTopK, topKCosine, type VectorHit, type VectorRow } from \"../vector.js\";\nimport {\n  buildPageClauses,\n  fromBlob,\n  fromJsonText,\n  joinWhere,\n  normalizeShareForStorage,\n  nullable,\n  ownerFieldsFromRaw,\n  ownerParamsFromRow,\n  timeRangeWhere,\n  toBlob,\n  toJsonText,\n} from \"./_helpers.js\";\n\nconst COLUMNS = [\n  \"id\",\n  \"episode_id\",\n  \"session_id\",\n  \"owner_agent_kind\",\n  \"owner_profile_id\",\n  \"owner_workspace_id\",\n  \"ts\",\n  \"user_text\",\n  \"agent_text\",\n  \"summary\",\n  \"tool_calls_json\",\n  \"reflection\",\n  \"agent_thinking\",\n  \"value\",\n  \"alpha\",\n  \"r_human\",\n  \"priority\",\n  \"tags_json\",\n  \"error_signatures_json\",\n  \"vec_summary\",\n  \"vec_action\",\n  \"share_scope\",\n  \"share_target\",\n  \"shared_at\",\n  \"turn_id\",\n  \"schema_version\",\n];\n\nexport type TraceSearchMeta = {\n  ts: number;\n  priority: number;\n  value: number;\n  episode_id: EpisodeId;\n  session_id: SessionId;\n  owner_agent_kind?: string;\n  owner_profile_id?: string;\n  owner_workspace_id?: string | null;\n  tags_json?: string;\n  error_signatures_json?: string;\n};\n\n/**\n * Narrow row shape returned by {@link listDedupRowsForEpisode}. [pluginDir, path.join(pluginDir, \"src\")] : [];\n  if (typeof __dirname === \"string\") bases.push(path.resolve(__dirname, \"..\"), __dirname);\n  const candidates = bases.map((b) => path.join(b, \"telemetry.credentials.json\"));\n  for (const credPath of candidates) {\n    try {\n      const raw = fs.readFileSync(credPath, \"utf-8\");\n      const creds = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<TelemetryCredentials>;\n      if (creds.endpoint) {\n        return { endpoint: creds.endpoint, pid: creds.pid ?? \"\", env: creds.env ?? \"prod\" };\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // Intentionally swallowed — try next candidate.\n    }\n  }\n  return { endpoint: \"\", pid: \"\", env: \"prod\" };\n}\n\nconst FLUSH_AT = 10;\nconst FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS = 30_000;\nconst SEND_TIMEOUT_MS = event_id: string;\n  times: number;\n}\n\nexport class Telemetry {\n  private distinctId: string;\n  private enabled: boolean;\n  private pluginVersion: string;\n  private log: Logger;\n  private private armsEndpoint: string;\n  private armsPid: string;\n  private armsEnv: string;\n\n  constructor(\n    config: TelemetryConfig,\n    stateDir: string,\n    pluginVersion: string,\n    log: Logger,\n    pluginDir?: string,\n  ) {\n    this.log = log;\n    this.pluginVersion = pluginVersion;\n    this.enabled = config.enabled !== false;\n    this.distinctId = this.loadOrCreateAnonymousId(stateDir);\n    this.firstSeenDate = this.loadOrCreateFirstSeen(stateDir);\n    this.sessionId = this.loadOrCreateSessionId(stateDir);\n    this.dailyPingFile = path.join(stateDir, \"memos-local\", \".last-daily-ping\");\n\n    const creds = loadTelemetryCredentials(pluginDir);\n    this.armsEndpoint = creds.endpoint;\n    this.armsPid = creds.pid;\n    this.armsEnv = creds.env;\n\n    if (!this.enabled || !this.armsEndpoint) {\n      this.enabled = false;\n      this.log.debug(\n        !this.armsEndpoint\n          ? \"Telemetry disabled (no credentials configured)\"\n          : \"Telemetry disabled (opt-out)\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.flushTimer = setInterval(() => void this.flush(), FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS);\n    if (this.flushTimer.unref) this.flushTimer.unref();\n    this.log.debug(\"Telemetry initialized (ARMS)\");\n  }\n\n  // ─── State persistence ───\n\n  private loadOrCreateAnonymousId(stateDir: string): string {\n    const dir = path.join(stateDir, \"memos-local\");\n    const idFile = path.join(dir, \".anonymous-id\");\n    try {\n      const existing = fs.readFileSync(idFile, \"utf-8\").trim();\n type: \"node\",\n      },\n      user: { id: this.distinctId },\n      session: { id: this.sessionId },\n      net: {},\n      view: { id: \"plugin\", name: VIEW_NAME },\n      events,\n      _v: \"1.0.0\",\n    };\n  }\n\n  private async flush(): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.buffer.length === 0) return;\n    const batch = this.buffer.splice(0);\n    const payload = this.buildPayload(batch);\n\n    try {\n      const resp = await fetch(this.armsEndpoint, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"text/plain\" },\n        body: agent_name: agentName });\n    this.maybeSendDailyPing();\n  }\n\n  trackTurnStart(agentName: string, latencyMs: number, hitCount: number): void {\n    this.capture(\"memos_search\", {\n       "path": "apps/memos-local-plugin/server/http.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * HTTP server entry point.\n *\n * Built on the Node standard library's `http` module — no framework. We\n * pay the small cost of writing a router by hand to keep the surface\n * area tiny, which in turn lets us guarantee the security properties\n * spelled out in `ALGORITHMS.md` (loopback default, API-key gating,\n * static-root escape prevention, etc.).\n *\n * ## Single-agent URL layout\n *\n * Each agent runs its own viewer on its own port:\n *\n *   - openclaw → :18799\n *   - hermes   → :18800\n *   - deepseek-harness → :18801\n *\n * The server hosts the SPA at `/`, the JSON REST API at `/api/v1/*`,\n * and the static viewer assets. There are no `/openclaw/*` /\n * `/hermes/*` URL prefixes — clients always talk to the agent's own\n * port. If both OpenClaw and Hermes are installed, their root path renders a\n * small picker page that links to the *other* agent's URL (external link, no\n * reverse proxy, no peer cores).\n */\n\nimport { randomUUID } from \"node:crypto\";\nimport { createServer, type IncomingMessage, type ServerResponse } from \"node:http\";\n\nimport { rootLogger } from \"../core/logger/index.js\";\n\nimport { buildRoutes } from \"./routes/registry.js\";\nimport { readBody, writeJson, writeNotFound, writeMethodNotAllowed } from \"./middleware/io.js\";\nimport { enforceApiKey } from \"./middleware/auth.js\";\nimport { requireSession } from \"./routes/auth.js\";\nimport { serveStatic } from \"./middleware/static.js\";\nimport type { ServerDeps, ServerHandle, ServerOptions } from \"./types.js\";\n\ntype AgentName = \"openclaw\" | \"hermes\";\ntype AgentPrefix = AgentName | \"memos\";\nconst AGENT_PREFIXES: readonly AgentPrefix[] = [\"openclaw\", \"hermes\", \"memos\"];\n\n/**\n * Well-known per-agent viewer port. The picker page links to the\n * peer agent here. If a user moves a peer to a non-default port the\n * link will 404 — that's the intended trade-off for keeping the picker\n * fully static (no IPC, no port scanning).\n */\nconst AGENT_DEFAULT_PORTS: Record<AgentName, number> = {\n  openclaw: 18799,\n  hermes: 18800,\n};\nconst DEFAULT_MAX_BODY_BYTES = 1_048_576;\nconst IMPORT_MAX_BODY_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024;\n\nexport async function startHttpServer(\n  deps: ServerDeps,\n  options: ServerOptions = {},\n): Promise<ServerHandle> {\n  const runtimeOptions: ServerOptions = {\n    ...options,\n    instanceId: options.instanceId?.trim() || randomUUID(),\n  };\n  const log = rootLogger.child({ channel: \"server.http\" });\n  const host = runtimeOptions.host ?? \"127.0.0.1\";\n  const port = runtimeOptions.port ?? 0;\n  const extraHeaders = runtimeOptions.extraHeaders ?? {};\n\n  const routes = buildRoutes(deps, runtimeOptions);\n  const closeActiveSseOnShutdown = runtimeOptions.closeActiveSseOnShutdown ?? false;\n  const activeSseResponses = new Set<ServerResponse>();\n  let closing = false;\n\n  const trackSseResponse = (req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse): void => {\n    if (!closeActiveSseOnShutdown) return;\n    if (!isSseResponse(req, res, runtimeOptions.agent) || res.destroyed || res.writableEnded) {\n      return;\n    }\n    if (closing) {\n      res.destroy();\n      return;\n    }\n    activeSseResponses.add(res);\n    const forget = () => activeSseResponses.delete(res);\n    res.once(\"close\", forget);\n    res.once(\"finish\", forget);\n  };\n  const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {\n    res.once(\"finish\", () => {\n      // A request that was active when close() began has just become idle.\n      // Drop only that keep-alive state; never terminate the handler early.\n      if (closing) server.closeIdleConnections();\n    });\n    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(extraHeaders)) {\n      res.setHeader(k, v);\n    }\n    try {\n      await dispatch(req, res, routes, deps, runtimeOptions, log);\n      trackSseResponse(req, res);\n    } catch (err) {\n      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);\n      log.error(\"request.unhandled\", { path: req.url, err: msg });\n      if (!res.headersSent) {\n        writeJson(res, 500, { error: { code: \"internal\", message: msg } });\n      }\n      try {\n        res.end();\n      } catch {\n        // best-effort — connection may already be closed\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  // Single bind attempt. EADDRINUSE is propagated so the caller\n  // (`bridge.cts` / `adapters/openclaw`) can log it and run headless.\n  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {\n    const onErr = (e: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => reject(e);\n    server.once(\"error\", onErr);\n    server.listen(port, host, () => {\n      server.off(\"error\", onErr);\n      resolve();\n    });\n  });\n\n  const addr = server.address();\n  const actualPort = typeof addr === \"object\" && addr ? addr.port : port;\n  const url = `http://${host === \"0.0.0.0\" ? \"127.0.0.1\" : host}:${actualPort}`;\n  let closed = false;\n  let closePromise: Promise<void> | null = null;\n\n  log.info(\"server.started\", { url, port: actualPort });\n\n  return {\n    url,\n    port: actualPort,\n    get closed() {\n      return closed;\n    },\n    close() {\n      if (closePromise) return closePromise;\n      closePromise = (async () => {\n        closing = true;\n        // Stop accepting first, then, when opted in, terminate only\n        // long-lived SSE responses.\n        // Ordinary in-flight HTTP handlers are allowed to finish before the\n        // server closes so they cannot race memory-core/SQLite shutdown.\n        const stopped = new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.close(() => resolve()));\n        server.closeIdleConnections();\n        if (closeActiveSseOnShutdown) {\n          for (const response of activeSseResponses) response.destroy();\n        }\n        await stopped;\n        closed = true;\n        log.info(\"server.stopped\", {});\n      })();\n      return closePromise;\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction isSseResponse(\n  req: IncomingMessage,\n  res: ServerResponse,\n  selfAgent: ServerOptions[\"agent\"],\n): boolean {\n  if ((req.method ?? \"GET\").toUpperCase() !== \"GET\" || res.statusCode !== 200) {\n    return false;\n  }\n  let pathname = new URL(req.url ?? \"/\", \"http://localhost\").pathname;\n  for (const name of AGENT_PREFIXES) {\n    const prefix = `/${name}`;\n    if (pathname !== prefix && !pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`)) continue;\n    if (name !== \"memos\" && name !== selfAgent) return false;\n    pathname = pathname.slice(prefix.length) || \"/\";\n    break;\n  }\n  return pathname === \"/api/v1/events\" || pathname === \"/api/v1/logs\";\n}\n\nasync function dispatch(\n  req: IncomingMessage,\n  res: ServerResponse,\n  routes: ReturnType<typeof buildRoutes>,\n  deps: ServerDeps,\n  options: ServerOptions,\n  log: ReturnType<typeof rootLogger.child>,\n): Promise<void> {\n  const url = new URL(req.url ?? \"/\", \"http://localhost\");\n  const method = (req.method ?? \"GET\").toUpperCase();\n  let pathname = url.pathname;\n\n  const selfAgent = options.agent ?? null;\n\n  // Backwards-compat for the old single-port \"hub/peer\" layout, where\n  // every URL was prefixed (`/openclaw/api/v1/...` or\n  // `/hermes/...`). New installs serve the SPA at root, but old\n  // bookmarks (and the old `AGENT_PREFIX` baked into older viewer\n  // bundles) still hit the prefixed paths.\n  //\n  // Two cases:\n  //   - Prefix matches THIS agent → drop the prefix and continue\n  //     dispatching internally. We must NOT 302 here, because POST /\n  //     PATCH / DELETE get downgraded to GET on a 302 in most browsers,\n  //     which would silently corrupt mutations.\n  //   - Prefix matches the OTHER agent → that agent lives on its own\n  //     port now, so 302 the user there. (We accept the request-method\n  //     downgrade because cross-port redirects are inherently a \"follow\n  //     this link\" gesture; the SPA bundle on the other port re-issues\n  //     mutations from form state, not from the original POST body.)\n  for (const name of AGENT_PREFIXES) {\n    const prefix = `/${name}`;\n    if (pathname === prefix || pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`)) {\n      const tail = pathname.slice(prefix.length) || \"/\";\n      if (name === \"memos\" || name === selfAgent) {\n        pathname = tail;\n        break;\n      }\n      const peerPort = AGENT_DEFAULT_PORTS[name];\n      const targetHost = req.headers[\"host\"]?.split(\":\")[0] ?? \"127.0.0.1\";\n      res.writeHead(302, {\n        Location: `http://${targetHost}:${peerPort}${tail}${url.search}`,\n      });\n      res.end();\n      return;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Static assets first — cheapest path. Serve on GET/HEAD only.\n  // The root path falls through to the static handler which serves\n  // `index.html` (the SPA). There is no picker page: each agent owns\n  // its own port and is reachable directly. The SPA's header probes\n  // the peer's well-known port and surfaces a small link if it's up.\n  if ((method === \"GET\" || method === \"HEAD\") && !pathname.startsWith(\"/api/\")) {\n    const served = await serveStatic(res, pathname, options);\n    if (served) return;\n  }\n\n  // API key gating — applies to every /api/* route (host-configured).\n  if (pathname.startsWith(\"/api/\") && options.apiKey) {\n    const allowed = enforceApiKey(req, res, options.apiKey);\n    if (!allowed) return;\n  }\n\n  // Session-cookie gating — applies only when the operator has\n  // enabled password protection (i.e. `~/.../memos-plugin/.auth.json`\n  // exists). Auth endpoints + `/health` are explicitly allowed so\n  // the viewer can complete login even from a locked state.\n  if (pathname.startsWith(\"/api/\") && deps.home?.root) {\n    const ok = requireSession(\n      req,\n      res,\n      String(deps.home.root),\n      pathname,\n      selfAgent,\n    );\n    if (!ok) return;\n  }\n\n  // Flat router lookup.\n  const key = `${method} ${pathname}`;\n  const exact = routes.getExact(key);\n  if (exact) {\n    const body = await readBody(req, bodyLimitForPath(pathname, options.maxBodyBytes));\n    const result = await exact({ req, res, url, body, deps, params: {} });\n    if (!res.headersSent && result !== undefined) {\n      writeJson(res, 200, result);\n    }\n    return;\n  }\n\n  // Pattern-route fallback (e.g. `/api/v1/traces/:id`).\n  const pattern = routes.matchPattern(method, pathname);\n  if (pattern) {\n    const body = await readBody(req, bodyLimitForPath(pathname, options.maxBodyBytes));\n    const result = await pattern.handler({\n      req,\n      res,\n      url,\n      body,\n      deps,\n      params: pattern.params,\n    });\n    if (!res.headersSent && result !== undefined) {\n      writeJson(res, 200, result);\n    }\n    return;\n  }\n\n  // Differentiate \"route exists, wrong method\" from \"no such route\".\n  if (routes.pathMatches(pathname)) {\n    writeMethodNotAllowed(res, method);\n    return;\n  }\n\n  writeNotFound(res);\n  log.debug(\"route.not_found\", { path: pathname, method });\n  void deps;\n}\n\nfunction bodyLimitForPath(pathname: string, configured?: number): number {\n  if (configured !== undefined) return configured;\n  return pathname === \"/api/v1/import\" ? IMPORT_MAX_BODY_BYTES : DEFAULT_MAX_BODY_BYTES;\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "apps/memos-local-plugin/server/routes/auth.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Viewer password gate.\n *\n * Opt-in security for the Memory Viewer — when the operator enables\n * password protection (Settings → 账户 → \"启用密码保护\"), every\n * `/api/v1/*` request MUST carry a valid session cookie issued by\n * this module. When password protection is OFF (the default,\n * preserves zero-config install.sh behaviour), this module is a\n * no-op and the API is reachable from localhost without auth.\n *\n * Storage shape:\n *\n *   $HOME/.auth.json  (mode 0600)\n *     {\n *       \"version\": 1,\n *       \"hash\": \"<scrypt-hash>\",  // password-derived key\n *       \"salt\": \"<base64>\",\n *       \"sessionSecret\": \"<base64>\",\n *       \"createdAt\": <epochMs>\n *     }\n *\n * We use Node's built-in `scrypt` (no bcrypt dep) with N=16384,r=8,p=1\n * and a 32-byte key. Sessions are HMAC-SHA256 signed JSON with a\n * 7-day rolling TTL — refreshed on every successful request.\n *\n * ## Multi-agent cookie scoping\n *\n * Browsers do NOT isolate cookies by port — `localhost:18799`\n * (openclaw) and `localhost:18800` (hermes) share a single cookie\n * jar. Same goes for the hub layout where one server proxies\n * `/openclaw/*` and `/hermes/*` from the same origin. If both\n * agents wrote the same cookie name (`memos_sess`) with `Path=/`,\n * a login on hermes would silently overwrite the openclaw cookie\n * (and vice versa) → refreshing one viewer would log the other one\n * out, because each agent signs sessions with its own\n * `sessionSecret`.\n *\n * To stay isolated we name the cookie `memos_sess_<agent>` (e.g.\n * `memos_sess_openclaw`, `memos_sess_hermes`). Both cookies coexist\n * in the browser's jar without conflict. When the host doesn't\n * advertise an agent (test fixtures, plain single-agent installs)\n * we fall back to the legacy `memos_sess` name so existing setups\n * continue to work unchanged.\n *\n * On the read side we additionally accept the legacy `memos_sess`\n * cookie when the per-agent one is missing. This means users who\n * were already logged in before the upgrade aren't kicked out the\n * first time they refresh — the next successful response will\n * write the new per-agent cookie and the transition is silent.\n *\n * Endpoints (public, no auth):\n *   - `GET  /api/v1/auth/status`\n *   - `POST /api/v1/auth/setup`   body: { password }\n *   - `POST /api/v1/auth/login`   body: { password }\n *   - `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`\n *\n * Everything else under `/api/v1/*` is gated by `requireSession`\n * (called from `server/http.ts::dispatch`).\n */\nimport {\n  existsSync,\n  chmodSync,\n  readFileSync,\n  writeFileSync,\n  mkdirSync,\n} from \"node:fs\";\nimport { dirname, join } from \"node:path\";\nimport {\n  randomBytes,\n  scryptSync,\n  timingSafeEqual,\n  createHmac,\n} from \"node:crypto\";\n\nimport type { ServerDeps, ServerOptions } from \"../types.js\";\nimport { parseJson, writeError, type Routes } from \"./registry.js\";\n\nconst SESSION_TTL_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;\nconst LEGACY_COOKIE_NAME = \"memos_sess\";\nconst SCRYPT_KEYLEN = 32;\n\n/**\n * Resolve the per-agent cookie name. Falls back to the legacy\n * `memos_sess` when no agent is configured (single-agent installs +\n * test fixtures) so unrelated callers continue to work.\n */\nfunction cookieNameFor(agent: string | null | undefined): string {\n  if (!agent) return LEGACY_COOKIE_NAME;\n  return `${LEGACY_COOKIE_NAME}_${agent}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Read the current session cookie, preferring the per-agent name and\n * silently falling back to the legacy name (for users upgrading from\n * a pre-fix viewer). Returns null when neither is present.\n */\nfunction readSessionCookie(\n  cookieHeader: string | undefined,\n  agent: string | null | undefined,\n): string | null {\n  const primary = cookieNameFor(agent);\n  const v = readCookie(cookieHeader, primary);\n  if (v) return v;\n  if (primary !== LEGACY_COOKIE_NAME) {\n    return readCookie(cookieHeader, LEGACY_COOKIE_NAME);\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\nexport interface AuthState {\n  version: 1;\n  hash: string;\n  salt: string;\n  sessionSecret: string;\n  createdAt: number;\n}\n\n/**\n * Serialise / deserialise the auth file. Sits alongside `config.yaml`\n * but is kept separate because it contains credentials.\n */\nfunction authPath(homeDir: string): string {\n  return join(homeDir, \".auth.json\");\n}\n\nexport function readAuthState(homeDir: string): AuthState | null {\n  const p = authPath(homeDir);\n  if (!existsSync(p)) return null;\n  try {\n    const raw = JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, \"utf8\")) as AuthState;\n    if (raw.version !== 1 || !raw.hash || !raw.salt || !raw.sessionSecret) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return raw;\n  } catch {\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction writeAuthState(homeDir: string, state: AuthState): void {\n  const p = authPath(homeDir);\n  mkdirSync(dirname(p), { recursive: true });\n  writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(state, null, 2), \"utf8\");\n  try {\n    chmodSync(p, 0o600);\n  } catch {\n    /* platform may not support — best-effort */\n  }\n}\n\nfunction hashPassword(\n  password: string,\n  saltBase64?: string,\n): { hash: string; salt: string } {\n  const salt = saltBase64\n    ? Buffer.from(saltBase64, \"base64\")\n    : randomBytes(16);\n  const key = scryptSync(password, salt, SCRYPT_KEYLEN);\n  return {\n    hash: key.toString(\"base64\"),\n    salt: salt.toString(\"base64\"),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction verifyPassword(password: string, state: AuthState): boolean {\n  const { hash } = hashPassword(password, state.salt);\n  return timingSafeEqual(\n    Buffer.from(hash, \"base64\"),\n    Buffer.from(state.hash, \"base64\"),\n  );\n}\n\n// ─── Session tokens (HMAC-SHA256 signed JSON) ──────────────────────────────\n\ninterface SessionPayload {\n  iat: number;\n  exp: number;\n}\n\nfunction signSession(state: AuthState, payload: SessionPayload): string {\n  const body = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(payload)).toString(\"base64url\");\n  const mac = createHmac(\"sha256\", Buffer.from(state.sessionSecret, \"base64\"))\n    .update(body)\n    .digest(\"base64url\");\n  return `${body}.${mac}`;\n}\n\nexport function verifySession(token: string, state: AuthState): boolean {\n  const dot = token.indexOf(\".\");\n  if (dot <= 0) return false;\n  const body = token.slice(0, dot);\n  const mac = token.slice(dot + 1);\n  const expected = createHmac(\"sha256\", Buffer.from(state.sessionSecret, \"base64\"))\n    .update(body)\n    .digest(\"base64url\");\n  if (mac.length !== expected.length) return false;\n  if (!timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(mac), Buffer.from(expected))) return false;\n  try {\n    const payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(body, \"base64url\").toString(\"utf8\")) as\n      | SessionPayload\n      | null;\n    if (!payload || typeof payload.exp !== \"number\") return false;\n    return Date.now() < payload.exp;\n  } catch {\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n// ─── Cookie helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport function readCookie(header: string | undefined, name: string): string | null {\n  if (!header) return null;\n  for (const part of header.split(\";\")) {\n    const eq = part.indexOf(\"=\");\n    if (eq < 0) continue;\n    const k = part.slice(0, eq).trim();\n    if (k === name) return part.slice(eq + 1).trim();\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\nfunction setSessionCookie(\n  res: { setHeader: (name: string, value: string | string[]) => void },\n  token: string,\n  agent: string | null | undefined,\n): void {\n  const name = cookieNameFor(agent);\n  res.setHeader(\"Set-Cookie\", [\n    `${name}=${token}; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=${Math.floor(\n      SESSION_TTL_MS / 1000,\n    )}`,\n  ]);\n}\n\nfunction clearSessionCookie(\n  res: { setHeader: (name: string, value: string | string[]) => void },\n  agent: string | null | undefined,\n): void {\n  const name = cookieNameFor(agent);\n  // Also clear the legacy name so users upgrading from a pre-fix\n  // viewer don't end up with two stale cookies after logout.\n  const cookies = [\n    `${name}=; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=0`,\n  ];\n  if (name !== LEGACY_COOKIE_NAME) {\n    cookies.push(\n      `${LEGACY_COOKIE_NAME}=; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=0`,\n    );\n  }\n  res.setHeader(\"Set-Cookie\", cookies);\n}\n\n// ─── Public routes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport function registerAuthRoutes(\n  routes: Routes,\n  deps: ServerDeps,\n  options: ServerOptions = {},\n): void {\n  const homeRoot = (): string | null => deps.home?.root ?? null;\n  const agent = options.agent ?? null;\n\n  routes.set(\"GET /api/v1/auth/status\", async (ctx) => {\n    const root = homeRoot();\n    if (!root) {\n      // Server has no home configured (e.g. test fixture) — treat as\n      // open to preserve existing test behaviour.\n      return { enabled: false, needsSetup: false, authenticated: true };\n    }\n    const state = readAuthState(root);\n    if (!state) {\n      // No password configured yet. First-run flow: frontend must\n      // show the SetupScreen before rendering the app shell. {\n    const root = homeRoot();\n    if (!root) {\n      writeError(ctx, 503, \"unavailable\", \"home not configured\");\n      return;\n    }\n    // Require a currently valid session before deleting       "content": "\"\"\"\nRequest context middleware for automatic trace_id injection.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport time\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nfrom starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware\nfrom starlette.requests import Request\nfrom starlette.responses import Response\n\nimport memos.log\n\nfrom memos.context.context import RequestContext, generate_trace_id, set_request_context\n\n\nlogger = memos.log.get_logger(__name__)\n\n\ndef extract_trace_id_from_headers(request: Request) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Extract trace_id from various possible headers with priority: g-trace-id > x-trace-id > trace-id.\"\"\"\n    for header in [\"g-trace-id\", \"x-trace-id\", \"trace-id\"]:\n        if trace_id := request.headers.get(header):\n            return trace_id\n    return None\n\n\nclass RequestContextMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):\n    \"\"\"\n    Middleware to automatically inject request context for every HTTP request.\n\n    This middleware:\n    1. Extracts trace_id from headers or generates a new one\n    2. Creates a RequestContext and sets it globally\n    3. Ensures the context is available throughout the request lifecycle\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, app, source: str | None = None):\n        \"\"\"\n        Initialize the middleware.\n\n        Args:\n            app: The ASGI application\n            source: Source identifier (e.g., 'product' or 'server') to distinguish request origin\n        \"\"\"\n        super().__init__(app)\n        self.source = source or \"api\"\n\n    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable) -> Response:\n        # Extract or generate trace_id\n        trace_id = extract_trace_id_from_headers(request) or generate_trace_id()\n\n        env = request.headers.get(\"x-env\")\n        user_type = request.headers.get(\"x-user-type\")\n        user_name = request.headers.get(\"x-user-name\")\n        start_time = time.time()\n\n        # Create and set request context\n        context = RequestContext(\n            trace_id=trace_id,\n            api_path=request.url.path,\n            env=env,\n            user_type=user_type,\n            user_name=user_name,\n            source=self.source,\n        )\n        set_request_context(context)\n\n        logger.info(\n            f\"Request started, source: {self.source}, method: {request.method}, path: {request.url.path}, \"\n            f\"headers: {request.headers}\"\n        )\n\n        response = await call_next(request)\n        end_time = time.time()\n\n        # Process the request\n        try:\n            if not response:\n                logger.error(\n                    f\"Request Failed No Response, path: {request.url.path}, status: {response.status_code}, cost: {(end_time - start_time) * 1000:.2f}ms\"\n                )\n\n                return response\n\n            if response.status_code == 200:\n                logger.info(\n                    f\"Request completed: source: {self.source}, path: {request.url.path}, status: {response.status_code}, cost: {(end_time - start_time) * 1000:.2f}ms\"\n                )\n            else:\n                logger.error(\n                    f\"Request Failed: source: {self.source}, path: {request.url.path}, status: {response.status_code}, cost: {(end_time - start_time) * 1000:.2f}ms\"\n                )\n        except Exception as e:\n            end_time = time.time()\n            logger.error(\n                f\"Request Exception Error: source: {self.source}, path: {request.url.path}, error: {e}, cost: {(end_time - start_time) * 1000:.2f}ms\"\n            )\n\n        return response\n"
    },

      "content": "\"\"\"\nServer API Router for MemOS (Class-based handlers version).\n\nThis router demonstrates the improved architecture using class-based handlers\nwith dependency injection, providing better modularity and maintainability.\n\nComparison with function-based approach:\n- Cleaner code: No need to pass dependencies in every endpoint\n- Better testability: Easy to mock handler dependencies\n- Improved extensibility: Add new handlers or modify existing ones easily\n- Clear separation of concerns: Router focuses on routing, handlers handle business logic\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport random as _random\nimport socket\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query\n\nfrom memos.api import handlers\nfrom memos.api.handlers.add_handler import AddHandler\nfrom memos.api.handlers.base_handler import HandlerDependencies\nfrom memos.api.handlers.chat_handler import ChatHandler\nfrom memos.api.handlers.cube_handler import CubeHandler\nfrom memos.api.handlers.feedback_handler import FeedbackHandler\nfrom memos.api.handlers.search_handler import SearchHandler\nfrom memos.api.product_models import (\n    AllStatusResponse,\n    APIADDRequest,\n    APIChatCompleteRequest,\n    APIFeedbackRequest,\n    APISearchRequest,\n    ChatBusinessRequest,\n    ChatPlaygroundRequest,\n    ChatRequest,\n    CreateCubeRequest,\n    CreateCubeResponse,\n    DeleteMemoryByRecordIdRequest,\n    DeleteMemoryByRecordIdResponse,\n    DeleteMemoryRequest,\n    DeleteMemoryResponse,\n    ExistMemCubeIdRequest,\n    ExistMemCubeIdResponse,\n    GetMemoryDashboardRequest,\n    GetMemoryPlaygroundRequest,\n    GetMemoryRequest,\n    GetMemoryResponse,\n    GetUserNamesByMemoryIdsRequest,\n    GetUserNamesByMemoryIdsResponse,\n    MemoryResponse,\n    RecoverMemoryByRecordIdRequest,\n    RecoverMemoryByRecordIdResponse,\n    RegisterCubeRequest,\n    RegisterCubeResponse,\n    SearchResponse,\n    StatusResponse,\n    SuggestionRequest,\n    SuggestionResponse,\n    TaskQueueResponse,\n)\nfrom memos.log import get_logger\nfrom memos.mem_scheduler.base_scheduler import BaseScheduler\nfrom memos.mem_scheduler.utils.status_tracker import TaskStatusTracker\n\n\nlogger = get_logger(__name__)\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/product\", tags=[\"Server API\"])\n\n# Instance ID for identifying this server instance in logs and responses\nINSTANCE_ID = f\"{socket.gethostname()}:{os.getpid()}:{_random.randint(1000, 9999)}\"\n\n# Initialize all server components\ncomponents = handlers.init_server()\n\n# Create dependency container\ndependencies = HandlerDependencies.from_init_server(components)\n\n# Initialize all handlers with dependency injection\nsearch_handler = SearchHandler(dependencies)\nadd_handler = AddHandler(dependencies)\nchat_handler = (\n    ChatHandler(\n        dependencies=dependencies,\n        chat_llms=components[\"chat_llms\"],\n        playground_chat_llms=components.get(\"playground_chat_llms\"),\n        search_handler=search_handler,\n        add_handler=add_handler,\n        online_bot=components.get(\"online_bot\"),\n    )\n    if os.getenv(\"ENABLE_CHAT_API\", \"false\") == \"true\"\n    else None\n)\nfeedback_handler = FeedbackHandler(dependencies)\ncube_handler = CubeHandler(dependencies)\n# Extract commonly used components[\"llm\"]\nsuggestion_llm = components.get(\"suggestion_llm\", llm)\nnaive_mem_cube = components[\"naive_mem_cube\"]\nredis_client = components[\"redis_client\"]\nstatus_tracker = TaskStatusTracker(redis_client=redis_client)\ngraph_db = components[\"graph_db\"]\n\n\n# =============================================================================\n# Search API Endpoints\n# =============================================================================\n\n\n@router.post(\"/search\", summary=\"Search memories\", response_model=SearchResponse)\ndef search_memories(search_req: APISearchRequest):\n    \"\"\"\n    Search memories for a specific user.\n\n    This endpoint uses the class-based SearchHandler for better code organization.\n    \"\"\"\n    search_results = search_handler.handle_search_memories(search_req)\n    return search_results\n\n\n# =============================================================================\n# Add API Endpoints\n# =============================================================================\n\n\n@router.post(\"/add\", summary=\"Add memories\", response_model=MemoryResponse)\ndef add_memories(add_req: APIADDRequest):\n    \"\"\"\n    Add memories for a specific user.\n\n    This endpoint uses the class-based AddHandler for better code organization.\n    \"\"\"\n    return add_handler.handle_add_memories(add_req)\n\n\n# =============================================================================\n# Cube Management API Endpoints\n# =============================================================================\n\n\n@router.post(\"/create_cube\", summary=\"Create a new memory cube\", response_model=CreateCubeResponse)\nasync def create_cube(request: CreateCubeRequest) -> CreateCubeResponse:\n    \"\"\"\n    Create a new memory cube for a user.\n\n    Memory cubes are containers that store different types of memories (textual,
